units: World x right/y down; heading CCW positive; raw body IMU yaw CW positive. Speed m/s; PID outputs percent.
guidance_basis: Experimental initial settings, not an identified hydrodynamic model. Straight 0.12 m/s; full curve-severity base speed 0.05 m/s. Hybrid tail gait and common propeller command are 1:1; yaw shifts tail bias only. New static-tail angle-radius trials are references, not a matched oscillating-tail model. Desired radius is a geometric request, not verified fish capability.
